suite: Read-only existing service and delegation authority
environment: local built Worker, local D1, synthetic data
limits: Original local metadata predicates only; no credential issuance/real provider auth/use/domain/formal acceptance.

checks.label: Initial index makes no selection or credential guess
Existing target owner binding and original predicate retained
Opaque owner actor IDs preserve original strings
Strict response rejects actor coercion
Secret extra fields never appear in projection
Unbound target is explicit without enabling connection
Expired original record is invalid exactly at expiry
Revoked record remains historical with expiry and revocation
Accountable owner inactive refuses original local eligibility
Accountable admin still matches original local owner predicate
Inactive original target cannot be called locally eligible
Wrong target kind remains unavailable
Original expiry is earliest required refresh
Original reporting delegation scope explicit, not patient access
Lost original grantor authority not in force
Suspended delegate not in force
Original ended delegation remains evidence
Revoked delegation remains evidence
Future original delegation start is refresh boundary not authority
Unknown authority ID cannot select a convenient neighbour
Stale operations version refuses
Malformed stored expiry never becomes valid
Duplicate authority references refuse response
Reply selected outside index refuses
Full original service100 bound unchanged
No clinical/private/provider configuration fields in reply
Read projection never changes original grants or operations
Invalid authority query refuses type=service&id=identity
Invalid authority query refuses type=service&id=identity&version=2&version=3
Invalid authority query refuses type=service&id=identity&version=02
Invalid authority query refuses type=service&id=identity&version=-1
Invalid authority query refuses type=unknown&id=identity&version=2
Invalid authority query refuses personId=patient
Exact explicit selection preserves zero operations version
New reader uses direct emptywindow without bootstrap or scheduled actions
